content.short: Multipli lets users borrow against tokenized real-world assets such as gold, stocks and Treasuries.
content.description: Multipli generates yield on tokenized real-world assets including gold, stocks, the S&P 500 and stablecoins, and lets holders borrow against them without selling. Collateral is held with regulated custodians and the strategies are run by established asset managers to institutional standards. Positions are over-collateralised and audited quarterly by both TradFi and DeFi audit teams. Multipli puts its user base above 90,000. The product operates on Monad among other chains.
content.meta: Borrow against tokenized gold, equities and Treasuries through the rwaUSD stablecoin.
